test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following remote controllers in split AC is used to start or stop the fast cooling?
solution:
The correct answer is __Turbo button**(Turbo)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Turbo button__ is used to start or stop fast cooling in split AC.
 
• When activated, the Turbo button enhances the cooling performance by operating the air conditioner at maximum power and fan speed.
 
• This feature is ideal for quickly cooling down the room temperature, especially during hot weather conditions.
 
• Turbo mode is generally disabled automatically after a certain period to save energy.
 
• Using the Turbo mode frequently may result in higher energy consumption compared to standard cooling modes.
